scope: Public summary of the dated latest-corpus run. Complete frozen sources and per-target evidence are retained in the private research companion. No private contents or host paths are embedded.

cohort.input_scope: 12 fixed ordinary-Python programs / 32 valid workloads plus 9 control, recursion and documented-error canaries; not full-Python or all-input proof

performance.timeout_policy: Censored whole-child runs have no complete VM CPU/wall/steps/throughput metrics. Independently accepted target counts remain correctness evidence.
performance.compile_deduplication: One compile per program/backend/style/repetition, shared across its inputs.
performance.step_budget_policy: Only known-insufficient step budgets increased after independent normal-HALT acceptance; original per-workload wall deadlines preserved.
performance.single_pass_timings: Exploratory; background load, frequency and thermal policy not controlled.

focused_test_scopes.scope: gate, runner and latest source-contract tests

original_nagoya_complex_comparison.compilation_boundary: Common C input; shared Python frontend excluded
original_nagoya_complex_comparison.timing_policy: One exploratory serial pair, uncontrolled load/frequency; source and binary hashes retained
original_nagoya_complex_comparison.original_initializer_build: Unchanged upstream Makefile defaults -g -O2 with Clang++ in isolated output
original_nagoya_complex_comparison.original_parser_build_limitation: Existing original parser binary hashes retained; historical compiler flags not re-audited
original_nagoya_complex_comparison.same_image_runtime_scope: Same port MB/input; whole-child CPU includes startup/read/validate/init/execute; uninstrumented original C-O3 versus frozen bounded Python
